g.text: A bullet begins the complete proof of one subgoal.
Rocq checks that it finishes before the next case begins.
Bullets are optional, but make structure visible and prevent
proofs for different subgoals from getting mixed together.
In the S case, reflexivity simplifies the successor expression
and the eqb match before checking equal sides.
Mark every point where multiple subgoals are generated.
Use line breaks and indentation that reveal their nesting.
(or 120 on a wide screen), rather than either extreme.
